data.name: Neon Angora: The Cabaret Club
data.detailed_description:
Neon Angora is an experimental social simulation powered by local AI (LLM) that shatters traditional gaming boundaries. The nightclub is merely a backdrop; the real stage is the human mind and the unscripted relationships you build. This game doesn't tell you what to do; it asks you who you want to be.

A Mind Simulation Without Boundaries Your interactions are not bound by pre-written dialogue trees. Thanks to local Llama.cpp integration, you can engage in completely free-form, real-time, and limitless conversations. Characters remember your history, shared information, and the nature of your relationship (RAG). Every conversation leaves a trace in their memory.

Whisper Mode: The Power of Information & Social Manipulation Step into the world of whispers. It’s not just about what is said, but who hears it:

  • Hidden Relationships & Betrayals: Discover the secret bonds between characters, use this knowledge to open new doors or shatter the existing order.

  • Dark Schemes: Help a character escape the club, leak inside information to rob the establishment, or execute complex escape plans involving secret keys and hidden gear.

  • Triggering Chaos: Feed the right info to the wrong person to trigger secret raids, uncover assassination plots, or pit characters against each other.

  • Elite Doctrines: Gain the locations of hidden weapon stashes or find martial arts manuals that will redefine your combat capabilities.

Club Dynamics & High-Stakes Action

  • A Living Ecosystem: NPCs don't just wait for you; they gossip and share info among themselves. Secrets circulate dynamically within the club.

  • Action and Crime: When talk isn't enough, engage in armed or unarmed combat. Extort the club, attempt a high-stakes robbery, or solve deep, unknown mysteries.

  • True Replayability: NPC preferences, secrets, and alliances are randomised every time. Replayability isn't about "doing the same thing better"; it's about entering the club as a completely different person.

This game doesn't tell you what to do. It asks who you want to be. Every decision leaves a trace. Every conversation kills or creates a possibility. Here, stories are not written. They are living.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600, Intel i5-10400F
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 / RTX 3060 (8GB VRAM) / AMD RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 18 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Players using Intel Arc A770 or AMD RX 6600 XT (and above) are highly recommended to use the Vulkan API in AI Settings for experience
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 7600X, Intel Core i5-14600K
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 5090 :D / (12GB VRAM or More)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 18 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Players using RX 9070 XT are highly recommended to use the Vulkan API in AI Settings for experience
